SELECT candles.id, candles.instrument_id, candles.timeframe, candles.start, candles."end", candles.open, candles.high, candles.low, candles.close, candles.complete, candles.revision, candles.received_at, candles.observed_at, candles.volume, candles.volume_complete, candles.volume_received_at, candles.volume_revision 
FROM candles 
WHERE candles.instrument_id = $1::VARCHAR AND candles.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR AND candles.start >= $3::BIGINT AND candles.start < $4::BIGINT ORDER BY candles.start

SELECT chart_publication_state.instrument_id, chart_publication_state.timeframe, chart_publication_state.requested, chart_publication_state.processed, chart_publication_state.reasons, chart_publication_state.requested_at, chart_publication_state.served_at, chart_publication_state.last_service_seq, chart_publication_state.next_at, chart_publication_state.attempts, chart_publication_state.blocked_reason, instruments.id, instruments.label, instruments.source, instruments.symbol, instruments.basis, instruments.calendar, instruments.calendar_profile, instruments.precision, instruments.quality, instruments.last_received, instruments.error, instruments.enabled 
FROM chart_publication_state JOIN instruments ON instruments.id = chart_publication_state.instrument_id 
WHERE chart_publication_state.requested > chart_publication_state.processed AND chart_publication_state.next_at <= $1::BIGINT ORDER BY chart_publication_state.last_service_seq, chart_publication_state.requested_at, chart_publication_state.instrument_id, chart_publication_state.timeframe 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER FOR UPDATE OF instruments SKIP LOCKED

SELECT chart_aggregation_jobs.kind, chart_aggregation_jobs.id, chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id, chart_aggregation_jobs.timeframe, chart_aggregation_jobs.start, chart_aggregation_jobs."end", chart_aggregation_jobs.created_at, chart_aggregation_jobs.attempts, chart_aggregation_jobs.next_at, chart_aggregation_jobs.error, instruments.id AS id_1, instruments.label, instruments.source, instruments.symbol, instruments.basis, instruments.calendar, instruments.calendar_profile, instruments.precision, instruments.quality, instruments.last_received, instruments.error AS error_1, instruments.enabled 
FROM chart_aggregation_jobs JOIN instruments ON instruments.id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id 
WHERE chart_aggregation_jobs.next_at <= $1::BIGINT ORDER BY CASE WHEN (chart_aggregation_jobs.created_at <= $2::BIGINT) THEN $3::INTEGER WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT chart_viewport_demands.id 
FROM chart_viewport_demands 
WHERE chart_viewport_demands.instrument_id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id AND chart_viewport_demands.expires > $4::BIGINT AND CASE WHEN (chart_viewport_demands.timeframe = $5::VARCHAR) THEN $6::VARCHAR ELSE chart_viewport_demands.timeframe END = chart_aggregation_jobs.timeframe AND chart_aggregation_jobs.start < chart_viewport_demands."end" AND chart_aggregation_jobs."end" > chart_viewport_demands.start AND chart_viewport_demands.focused IS true)) THEN $7::INTEGER WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT chart_viewport_demands.id 
FROM chart_viewport_demands 
WHERE chart_viewport_demands.instrument_id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id AND chart_viewport_demands.expires > $4::BIGINT AND CASE WHEN (chart_viewport_demands.timeframe = $5::VARCHAR) THEN $6::VARCHAR ELSE chart_viewport_demands.timeframe END = chart_aggregation_jobs.timeframe AND chart_aggregation_jobs.start < chart_viewport_demands."end" AND chart_aggregation_jobs."end" > chart_viewport_demands.start)) THEN $8::INTEGER WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT chart_viewport_demands.id 
FROM chart_viewport_demands 
WHERE chart_viewport_demands.instrument_id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id AND chart_viewport_demands.expires > $4::BIGINT AND chart_aggregation_jobs.start < chart_viewport_demands."end" AND chart_aggregation_jobs."end" > chart_viewport_demands.warm_start AND chart_viewport_demands.focused IS true)) THEN $9::INTEGER WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT chart_viewport_demands.id 
FROM chart_viewport_demands 
WHERE chart_viewport_demands.instrument_id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id AND chart_viewport_demands.expires > $4::BIGINT AND chart_aggregation_jobs.start < chart_viewport_demands."end" AND chart_aggregation_jobs."end" > chart_viewport_demands.warm_start)) THEN $10::INTEGER WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT chart_viewport_demands.id 
FROM chart_viewport_demands 
WHERE chart_viewport_demands.instrument_id = chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id AND chart_viewport_demands.expires > $4::BIGINT)) THEN $11::INTEGER ELSE $12::INTEGER END, CASE WHEN (chart_aggregation_jobs.created_at <= $2::BIGINT) THEN chart_aggregation_jobs.created_at ELSE -chart_aggregation_jobs."end" END, chart_aggregation_jobs.created_at, chart_aggregation_jobs.id 
 LIMIT $13::INTEGER FOR UPDATE OF instruments SKIP LOCKED

SELECT chart_publication_jobs.instrument_id, chart_publication_jobs.timeframe, chart_publication_jobs.start, chart_publication_jobs."end" 
FROM chart_publication_jobs 
WHERE chart_publication_jobs.instrument_id = $1::VARCHAR AND chart_publication_jobs.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR AND (chart_publication_jobs.start >= $3::BIGINT AND chart_publication_jobs.start < $4::BIGINT OR (EXISTS (SELECT chart_published_bars.start 
FROM chart_published_bars 
WHERE chart_published_bars.instrument_id = $5::VARCHAR AND chart_published_bars.timeframe = $6::VARCHAR AND chart_published_bars.start = chart_publication_jobs.start AND chart_published_bars.complete IS true))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT chart_aggregation_jobs.id 
FROM chart_aggregation_jobs 
WHERE chart_aggregation_jobs.instrument_id = $7::VARCHAR AND chart_aggregation_jobs.timeframe = $8::VARCHAR AND chart_aggregation_jobs.start < chart_publication_jobs."end" AND chart_aggregation_jobs."end" > chart_publication_jobs.start)) ORDER BY chart_publication_jobs.start DESC 
 LIMIT $9::INTEGER

($1::VARCHAR, $2::VARCHAR, $3::BIGINT, $4::BIGINT, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::INTEGER, $11::BIGINT, $12::BIGINT, $13, $14, $15::BIGINT, $16::INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, timeframe, start) DO UPDATE SET "end" = excluded."end", open = excluded.open, high = excluded.high, low = excluded.low, close = excluded.close, complete = excluded.complete, revision = CASE WHEN (candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete) THEN candles.revision + $17::INTEGER ELSE candles.revision END, received_at = CASE WHEN (candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete) THEN $18::BIGINT ELSE candles.received_at END, observed_at = excluded.observed_at, volume = excluded.volume, volume_complete = excluded.volume_complete, volume_received_at = CASE WHEN (excluded.volume_received_at > candles.volume_received_at) THEN excluded.volume_received_at ELSE candles.volume_received_at END, volume_revision = CASE WHEN (candles.volume IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume OR candles.volume_complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume_complete) THEN candles.volume_revision + $19::INTEGER ELSE candles.volume_revision END WHERE candles."end" IS DISTINCT FROM excluded."end" OR candles.open IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.open OR candles.high IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.high OR candles.low IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.low OR candles.close IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.close OR candles.complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.complete OR candles.volume IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume OR candles.volume_complete IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.volume_complete OR excluded.observed_at > candles.observed_at OR excluded.volume_received_at > candles.volume_received_at RETURNING candles.id
